Heart Disease in Young Adults: Is It Increasing in Metro Cities?

It’s becoming common. In 2026, ICUs aren’t just full of elders – young patients are frequently admitted too. Doctors now see this so often they hardly blink. What used to be rare before age sixty shows up decades earlier.

A shift few saw coming! Life’s pace here plays its part. Stress piles on without warning signs. Bodies react in ways we’re only beginning to grasp. Food choices matter more than some think.  Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD) reduces blood flow to your limbs, especially your legs. Many dismiss it as “just aging,” but it’s often the sign of something deeper — like clogged arteries.

 • Pain while walking
 • Cold feet or numbness
 • Wounds that don’t heal

Diabetes is a disease in which the blood vessels are the first and most severely affected.
Whenever blood vessels are affected, atherosclerosis develops. Due to damage, platelet plugs start forming, and cholesterol begins to accumulate in these areas. As a result, the arteries gradually start getting blocked.
Because of this, heart attacks become very common in diabetic patients.
Happy Republic Day

Common Heart Tests & What They Detect
ECG (Electrocardiogram) - Records the heart’s electrical activity to detect rhythm problems & signs of a past or ongoing heart attack.
Stress Test (TMT) - Checks how well the heart works during exercise or stress and helps identify hidden blockages.
2D Echo (Echocardiography) - An ultrasound test that shows heart size, pumping strength, and valve function.
Invasive Coronary Angiography - Gold standard test to find heart artery blockages and decide the best treatment.
Each Heart Test Has A Specific Purpose - Doctors choose the right test based on symptoms, risk factors, and clinical assessment.

Understanding Parkinson’s Disease 🧠🤝

Parkinson’s is more than just "shaking." It is a progressive brain disorder that affects movement, occurring when vital nerve cells in the brain—the ones responsible for coordination—slowly stop working. 📉

In our latest guide, we break down the key signs and facts through the journey of a senior member of our community.

Early awareness is the first step toward better care!

Key Symptoms to Watch For:

Tremors:
Involuntary shaking, often starting in the hands or fingers. 👋

Stiffness (Rigidity):
Muscle tension that makes it hard to move or swing arms while walking. 🪵

Bradykinesia:
Slowed physical movement, making simple tasks take longer. 🚶‍♂️⏳

Balance Issues:
Difficulty maintaining an upright posture or frequent falls. ⚖️

Important Facts:
Progressive Nature: Symptoms usually develop gradually and can change over time. 🗓️

Management is Key: While there is currently no cure, modern treatments, therapies, and lifestyle changes can significantly improve quality of life. 💊🍎

🔥 HEAT STROKE IS A MEDICAL EMERGENCY
— DON’T IGNORE THE HEAT! ☀️

As temperatures rise, so does the risk of heat-related illnesses. Awareness can save lives.

🚨 Warning Signs of Heat Stroke:
• High body temperature (>40°C)
• Altered behavior / confusion
• Severe headache
• Nausea / vomiting
• Dizziness or fainting
• Hot, dry skin (sometimes sweating may persist)

⚠️ Who is at higher risk?
Elderly 👴 | Children 👶 | Outdoor workers 🚧 | Chronic illness patients | Dehydrated individuals

💧 Prevention Tips:
• Stay well hydrated (don’t wait for thirst)
• Avoid peak sun hours (12–4 PM)
• Wear light, loose cotton clothing
• Use caps/umbrellas when outdoors
• Never leave anyone in parked vehicles

🆘 What to do in emergency?
• Shift to a cool/shaded area immediately
• Start cooling (wet cloth, ice packs in axilla/groin)
• Give fluids if conscious
• Seek urgent medical care

👨‍⚕️ Early action can be life-saving.
Stay alert, stay safe!

featured_reviews.name: Sara Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: Dr. Mustufa is an incredible cardiologist. He genuinely listens to his patients and takes the time to explain complex heart health issues in simple terms. His compassionate approach completely put me at ease during a stressful time. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and caring heart specialist

featured_reviews.name: Taskeen Glass
featured_reviews.review_text: I had been referring my parents to Dr. Mustafa since few years for regular checks and treatment of heart diseases, blood pressures and sugar. We had CABG of my father done in 2009. Since few years Dr. Mustafa is our first point consulting 24x7. More than the treatment my parents feels comfortable and treated just via a phone call and a conversation with him. He takes time, listens and comforts the patient while prescribing medicines, being his best part. We wish him best and may he serves humanity at large. Regards, Murtaza.

featured_reviews.name: Fatema Chiba
featured_reviews.review_text: Dr. Mustafa is an amazing doctor who truly cares about his patients. He takes the time to explain everything clearly, listens attentively, and answers all questions with patience. His positive attitude and kindness make you feel at ease and supported from the very start. We felt completely confident and well looked after throughout the treatment. Highly recommend him!

featured_reviews.name: Gayle Braganza
featured_reviews.review_text: During a very frightening time for our family, Dr. Mustafa Taskeen was nothing short of a lifeline. My mother was admitted to the ER in the U.S. with severe heart stress, and navigating the healthcare system felt painfully slow and uncertain. Despite not being directly there, he guided us through her treatment, helped us understand what was happening, and advised us on the best steps to stabilize her condition and provided a relevant medication course. His compassion, patience, and medical insight gave us clarity and hope when we were overwhelmed. I will always be deeply thankful and indebted for his support.

featured_reviews.name: andrew dhaneshwar
featured_reviews.review_text: We rushed my wife to the emergency due to a heart problem, and she came under the care of Dr. Mustafa Taskeen. From the very beginning, he was calm, approachable, and extremely reassuring during a very stressful time. He took the time to clearly explain the condition, walked us through the treatment plan, and patiently answered all our questions. His professionalism and genuine care made a huge difference in our experience. I would highly recommend Dr. Mustafa Taskeen to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and trustworthy heart specialist.

featured_reviews.name: naema alrahbi
featured_reviews.review_text: We met dr.Mustafa a cardiology consultant in Al Saifii Hospital. Dr Mustafa  provided exceptional care. He listened attentively to the paitent, conducted a thorough clinical assessment, and prescribed the appropriate medications. Beyond the medical treatment, he offered a comprehensive wellness plan to improve the patient overall health, which included regular exercise, yoga, deep breathing practices, walking, and maintaining a positive attitude in dealing with the illness. What impressed us most is his dedication—he follows up on  condition daily with tireless commitment, ensuring continuous support and guidance.

featured_reviews.name: Qusai Lakdawala
featured_reviews.review_text: Dr. Mustafa has been a true blessing for our family. He is very polite, calm, and patient while listening to every concern. He explains the diagnosis clearly and gives us confidence and reassurance during difficult times. His response is always prompt and caring. We are truly grateful for his guidance and support. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: shabbir halvadwala
featured_reviews.review_text: I want to express my deepest gratitude to Dr. Mustufa Taskeen for the exceptional care he provided to my Father  He was not only professional and knowledgeable but also kind and compassionate throughout the entire process. Our family truly appreciates the time he took to explain everything clearly and the genuine concern he showed for my father well-being. We are so grateful to have had such a skilled doctor  . Highly recommended!
